name: usage-insights
description: Standalone re-implementations of Claude Code's built-in /usage and /insights, reverse-engineered from the CLI binary. /usage programmatically computes session token usage and cost and has an agent analyze where API calls went; /insights scans your session transcripts, extracts facets via an agent, aggregates them, and renders the full shareable HTML report — all without relying on the built-in tooling.
